feature1.prompt: Add ModelAdmin.get_inlines() hook to allow set inlines based on the request or model instance. Currently, we can override the method get_inline_instances to achieve inline customization, but this requires copying a for loop into user code. By adding a dedicated hook get_inlines(request, obj=None), developers can more cleanly specify custom inlines based on request attributes or the model instance. This feature introduces the new hook to simplify custom inline handling.
feature1.hint_texts: This part focuses on introducing the new get_inlines method. It should be defined in the ModelAdmin class in django/contrib/admin/options.py. The new method must accept a request and an optional obj parameter, and by default, it should return self.inlines. This hook will enable developers to override inline behavior without rewriting iteration logic.
feature1.entrypoint: File: django/contrib/admin/options.py. Add the new method 'def get_inlines(self, request, obj):' immediately after the get_fieldsets method. The method should include a docstring (e.g., 'Hook for specifying custom inlines.') and return self.inlines.

tests.FAIL_TO_PASS: test_get_inlines_no_request_attribute (generic_inline_admin.tests.GenericInlineModelAdminTest) - should fail before the hook implementation and pass after implementing get_inlines.
tests.PASS_TO_PASS: test_get_inlines_with_request_attribute (generic_inline_admin.tests.GenericInlineModelAdminTest) - should pass by correctly returning the inline classes based on request attributes.

feature2.prompt: Modify ModelAdmin.get_inline_instances to utilize the new get_inlines hook for setting inlines based on the request or model instance. Instead of iterating directly over self.inlines, the method should call get_inlines to obtain a customized list of inline classes. This integration ensures that any override of get_inlines is respected and that inline instance creation dynamically adapts to the request or model instance. The change refactors inline instance retrieval to be more flexible and maintainable.
feature2.hint_texts: This part focuses on integrating the new get_inlines hook into the existing get_inline_instances method. Developers should update the for loop within get_inline_instances so that it iterates over self.get_inlines(request, obj) rather than self.inlines. This update guarantees that any customizations made by overriding get_inlines are carried forward into the creation of inline instances.
feature2.entrypoint: File: django/contrib/admin/options.py. Locate the get_inline_instances method and modify its loop: change 'for inline_class in self.inlines:' to 'for inline_class in self.get_inlines(request, obj):'. This modification should occur after the new get_inlines method definition in the same file.

tests.FAIL_TO_PASS: test_get_inline_instances_no_request_attribute (generic_inline_admin.tests.GenericInlineModelAdminTest) - should fail before the integration and pass after updating get_inline_instances to call get_inlines.
tests.PASS_TO_PASS: test_get_inline_instances_with_request_attribute (generic_inline_admin.tests.GenericInlineModelAdminTest) - should pass by correctly returning inline instances based on the inline classes provided by get_inlines.

collaboration_points.shared_resources: The file django/contrib/admin/options.py and the ModelAdmin class are common to both features, particularly the self.inlines property and the handling of request and obj parameters.
collaboration_points.integration_strategy: Feature1 provides the new get_inlines hook that standardizes inline retrieval, while Feature2 updates get_inline_instances to rely on that hook. Developers must ensure that get_inlines returns inline classes in a format that get_inline_instances can iterate over accurately.
collaboration_points.communication_needs: Both feature teams need to coordinate on the design and behavior of the get_inlines hook, ensuring consistency in how inline data is returned. Changes to the expected return type or method signature in Feature1 should be clearly communicated to the team handling Feature2.
